title.narrative: Promoting gender equality,resilience and sustainability through climate adaption

description.narrative: This project aims to advance gender equality, promote women's rights, and strengthen community resilience to climate and environmental challenges in Chadiza District and will target to reach 2000 beneficiaries (1500 female and 500 male). It focuses on empowering women and youths as central actors in sustainable development by increasing their access to economic opportunities, leadership roles, and climate-smart solutions. The project will support women's participation in leadership roles, environmental decision-making, resource accessibility and management to ensure that policies and practices reflect their priorities and protect their rights. Through capacity-building, skills training, and awareness campaigns, the project will equip women with knowledge on climate-smart agriculture, natural resource conservation, and adaptive livelihood strategies. It will also engage men, traditional leaders, and community structures to shift harmful gender norms, prevent discrimination, and create equitable spaces for women's active involvement and access to productive resources and bring about gender equality. Collaboration with various stakeholders, Civil society and local communities, the project will promote climate adaptation and mitigation mechanisms, conservation practices and sustainable resource use. By advancing gender equality and environmental resilience simultaneously, the project seeks to build stronger, more inclusive, and climate-resilient communities where women and girls can thrive and contribute meaningfully to long-term development.
